vi_block: Vết tích, dấu vết, di tích.
Bộ phận vết tích (của một cơ quan trước kia phát triển đầy đủ).

wiktionary.gloss: A mark left on the earth by a foot.

examples: the vestiges of ancient magnificence in Palmyra
vestiges of former population
wiktionary.gloss: A faint mark or visible sign left by something which is lost, or has perished, or is no longer present.
A vestigial organ; a non-functional organ or body part that was once functional in an evolutionary ancestor.
The remaining portion of a partially suppressed sideband.
In Greek folklore, a harmful undead creature that eats flesh, somewhat like a vampire or zombie.
